name: @finanfa/desktop
description: Desktop shell for finanfa-code: runs the web server in the background and shows the web UI in a native window.

scripts.start: npm run build -w @finanfa/web-client && npm run build && node scripts/start.mjs
scripts.smoke: npm run build -w @finanfa/web-client && npm run build && node scripts/start.mjs --smoke
scripts.pack: npm run build -w @finanfa/web-client && npm run build && npm run bundle && node scripts/installers.mjs --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build -w @finanfa/web-client && npm run build && npm run bundle && node scripts/installers.mjs
